name: MonarchAddressAutocomplete
title: AddressAutocomplete
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with a read-only androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField that opens androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet with MonarchSearchBar and a androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of suggestions; a form of MonarchTextField with androidx.compose.ui.autofill.ContentType address types and MonarchCountrySelect
summary: An address field with suggestions from the app's own provider: search, pick a suggestion, and the street, city, region, postal code and country fill in for review, with manual entry one step away.
whenToUse: For a postal address in checkout, billing, shipping or a profile, when the app has an address provider (its own endpoint, the Places SDK or android.location.Geocoder behind a suspending function).
whenNotToUse: Not for a place or point of interest on a map (use a map search), and not when no provider is available (use MonarchTextField fields with the address autofill content types, MonarchCountrySelect and MonarchRegionSelect).
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAddressAutocomplete(address: MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress, onAddressChange: (MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress) -> Unit, search: suspend (query: String) -> List<MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, mode: MonarchAddressAutocompleteMode? = null, onModeChange: ((MonarchAddressAutocompleteMode) -> Unit)? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, allowManualEntry: Boolean = true, minQueryLength: Int = 3, debounceMillis: Long = 300L, locale: Locale? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, fieldErrors: Map<MonarchAddressAutocompleteField, String> = emptyMap(), resolve: (suspend (MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion) -> MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress)? = null, onSuggestionSelect: ((MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion, MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress) -> Unit)? = null, searchIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, suggestionIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels = MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels())

@ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAddressAutocompleteInline(address: MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress, onAddressChange: (MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress) -> Unit, search: suspend (query: String) -> List<MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, mode: MonarchAddressAutocompleteMode? = null, onModeChange: ((MonarchAddressAutocompleteMode) -> Unit)? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, allowManualEntry: Boolean = true, minQueryLength: Int = 3, debounceMillis: Long = 300L, locale: Locale? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, fieldErrors: Map<MonarchAddressAutocompleteField, String> = emptyMap(), resolve: (suspend (MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion) -> MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress)? = null, onSuggestionSelect: ((MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion, MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress) -> Unit)? = null, searchIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, suggestionIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels = MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels())

data class MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress(line1: String = "", line2: String = "", city: String = "", region: String = "", postalCode: String = "", countryCode: String? = null) { val isEmpty: Boolean }
class MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(id: String, label: String, description: String? = null, address: MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress? = null)
enum class MonarchAddressAutocompleteField { Line1, Line2, City, Region, PostalCode, Country }

class MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels(label: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, searching: String? = null, resolving: String? = null, empty: String? = null, searchFailed: String? = null, resolveFailed: String? = null, enterManually: String? = null, backToSearch: String? = null, filled: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, line1: String? = null, line2: String? = null, city: String? = null, region: String? = null, postalCode: String? = null, country: String? = null, optional: String? = null, tooShort: ((length: Int) -> String)? = null, results: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: address
options.description: The address. A pick replaces it; the form edits its parts.

options.name: onAddressChange
options.description: Called with the new address after a pick, a manual entry or an edit of the form.

options.name: search
options.description: Returns the suggestions for the trimmed text. Throw to show "Couldn’t search addresses." with Try again. Cancelled when the text changes or the sheet closes.

options.name: mode
options.description: The search field only, or with the form, when the app owns it. null keeps it inside, starting on the form when the address has a street line.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the field, the form and the buttons can be used.

options.name: allowManualEntry
options.description: Offers "Enter the address manually" under the field and at the end of the list.

options.name: minQueryLength
options.description: The characters needed before search runs.

options.name: debounceMillis
options.description: How long to wait after typing before search runs. A newer text cancels the wait and the older search.

options.name: locale
options.description: The language of the country names in the summary and the country field. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error under the search field; the field is in the error state.

options.name: fieldErrors
options.description: Errors of the form's fields, shown under each field.

options.name: resolve
options.description: Turns a picked suggestion without an address into one. Throw to show the resolve error. Without it such a suggestion fills only the street line.

options.name: onSuggestionSelect
options.description: Receives the picked suggestion and the address it gave.

options.name: searchIcon
options.description: An icon at the start of the search field. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: suggestionIcon
options.description: A decorative icon at the start of each suggestion, such as a pin, tinted muted.

states.name: search, empty
states.description: The search field shows the placeholder, with "Enter the address manually" under it.

states.name: search, filled
states.description: The search field shows the address on one line, wrapping when long.

states.name: too short
states.description: The sheet asks for more characters and does not search.

states.name: searching
states.description: The sheet's search field shows its pending state and the status line says "Searching…".

states.name: suggestions
states.description: The sheet lists the suggestions under "2 addresses found", then the manual entry row.

states.name: no results
states.description: The sheet says "No addresses found" above the manual entry row.

states.name: search failed
states.description: MonarchInlineErrorRetry says "Couldn’t search addresses." with Try again, which reruns the same text.

states.name: resolving
states.description: A linear progress indicator labelled "Getting the address details…" shows under the field, and the field is disabled.

states.name: resolve failed
states.description: The resolve error is the field's error and is announced.

states.name: manual
states.description: The form shows street, apartment (optional), city, region, postal code and country, then "Search for an address".

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field, the form and the buttons take the disabled colors and nothing responds.

appearance: The search field and the form use MonarchTextField's colors: a surface fill with the input border, the danger strong color in error. The sheet is on the surface color; suggestion labels are the default text color and descriptions, icons and the status line the muted color; the manual entry and back buttons are ghost buttons. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Monarch adds no map or places SDK and makes no requests: search and resolve are the app's suspending functions, cancelled through coroutine cancellation instead of an AbortSignal (iOS uses async closures and task cancellation). MonarchAddressAutocomplete, as on iOS, opens the search in a bottom sheet; MonarchAddressAutocompleteInline lays it out as the web does, an editable field with the suggestions in a card under it. The form fields in both carry the platform's address autofill content types (AddressStreet, AddressAuxiliaryDetails, AddressLocality, AddressRegion, PostalCode); the country is a MonarchCountrySelect, which autofill does not fill. The field is a read-only exposed dropdown anchor, so TalkBack reads it as a control that expands, where iOS reads a button. The web's LocationFields adapter and idPrefix, and iOS's isRequired, are not offered; wrap the component in a form field for a required mark. The results count is shown as a visible status line as well as announced. Marked experimental, as a product composite, until a Rook app adopts it. The type names match iOS.
accessibility: The search field is a Material 3 exposed dropdown anchor named by its label ("Address"), whose value is the address on one line; the error is its error semantics.

In the sheet the title is a heading, and a status line that is always present is a polite live region: it reads "Searching…", the too-short hint, "No addresses found" or the number found as they change.
Each suggestion is one button, read as its label and description, at least 48dp high; the icon is decorative.
"Address filled in. Check the details." and the resolve error are announced through a polite live region that is always present.
The form fields are standard text fields named by their labels, with address autofill content types; the optional apartment line has "Optional" as helper text.
The manual entry, back, retry and Cancel controls are buttons at least 48dp high.
edgeCases: An answer that arrives after the text changed is dropped, because the coroutine that asked for it was cancelled.
A suggestion without an address and without resolve fills only the street line, for review.
Leaving the search for manual entry keeps an existing street line; otherwise the typed text becomes the street line.
Long addresses wrap in the search field; the form fields grow at font scale 2.0, so the component should sit in a vertically scrolling screen.
The country field lists the 249 ISO countries; a provider's code outside them is still shown.

examples.title: Search, pick and review
examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAddressAutocompleteInline(
    address = shipping,
    onAddressChange = { shipping = it },
    search = { query -> places.filter { it.label.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) } },
    helperText = {{helper}},
    required = {{required}},
    initialQuery = {{query}},
    searchIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Search, contentDescription = null) },
    initiallyOpen = true,
    labels = MonarchAddressAutocompleteLabels(label = {{label}}, enterManually = {{enterManually}}),
)
examples.setupTemplate:
var shipping by remember { mutableStateOf(MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress()) }
val places = remember {
    listOf(
        MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(
            id = {{places.0.id}},
            label = {{places.0.label}},
            description = {{places.0.description}},
            address = MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress(
                line1 = {{places.0.address.line1}},
                city = {{places.0.address.city}},
                region = {{places.0.address.region}},
                postalCode = {{places.0.address.postalCode}},
                countryCode = {{places.0.address.countryCode}},
            ),
        ),
        MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(
            id = {{places.1.id}},
            label = {{places.1.label}},
            description = {{places.1.description}},
            address = MonarchAddressAutocompleteAddress(
                line1 = {{places.1.address.line1}},
                city = {{places.1.address.city}},
                postalCode = {{places.1.address.postalCode}},
                countryCode = {{places.1.address.countryCode}},
            ),
        ),
        MonarchAddressAutocompleteSuggestion(
            id = {{places.2.id}},
            label = {{places.2.label}},
            description = {{places.2.description}},
        ),
    )
}
